title: Prang (Formerly SunWorks) Construction Paper, 10 Assorted Colors, 12" x 18", 50 Sheets

reviews.title: Quality Construction Paper
reviews.body: The size of the paper is perfect for any project. The colors are vibrant and a great variety to work with. I bought this pack to start making a sticker journal and it is perfect for creating little scenes with my stickers. Paper is good quality, exactly what you'd expect from construction paper. You can't beat the price for what you're getting with this product. If you are looking for a medium weight paper for your projects, this is for you. The paper is also smooth with the texture known for from construction paper. The paper isn't too thick and it isn't too thin either. You can't see through the paper, which is a plus. You can also draw on the paper with sharpies with little bleed through. Highly recommend this product. I honestly don't have any cons about this paper.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 20, 2026
reviews.author: Megan Smith

reviews.title: Must have for summer projects with the kids!
reviews.body: I bought two packages of this construction paper to stock up on summer crafting supplies for my grandchildren’s visits.The paper is of very good quality. Some other brands I’ve used tore easily. This paper has a nice thickness to it, folds and cuts easily.  You can use poster  paint or water colors on this paper and colors do not bleed or soak through. Crayons and markers are great on this paper as well.  My grandkids like to draw pictures with chalk on the darker colored paper. The paper has some texture to hold the colors of the chalk.It comes in all the basic colors you need for all kinds of projects.I am extremely pleased with my purchase.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 25, 2026
reviews.author: Suzy

reviews.title: Pay attention when you purchase.  Excellent paper but easy to buy too large sheets.
reviews.body: I am pleased with this selection, but I bought it inadvertently.  I meant to buy the standard paper size. So I guess I actually got a great deal!  The colors are bright and my 4 year old grandchild can easily use this paper for her crafts.  The sheets are thick and the color stays fast.

features: THE GO-TO, ALL-PURPOSE PAPER: Medium weight, groundwood construction provides the best value in school grade construction paper.
MANY USES: Bright and consistent color makes Prang construction paper perfect for school projects, arts & crafts, or just doodling.
EASILY CUTS AND FOLDS: Slightly textured construction paper allows for clean cuts and folds without cracking; recyclable.
HIGH QUALITY: Backed by our Prang Promise to replace any product that fails to meet your expectations.

TRUSTED BRAND: Prang is part of the Dixon Ticonderoga family of products which includes Ticonderoga, Dixon, Pacon, Tru-Ray, UCreate, Fadeless, Classroom Keepers, Bordette, Creativity Street, Spectra, Strathmore, Canson, Daler-Rowney, Lyra, Das, and more.
